1: One foot in front of the other.
This hill isn't going to push itself.
2: I swear this boulder got heavier.
At least the view is nice.
3: My legs are NOT happy about this.
4: The air is getting thinner up here.
Don't look down. Don't look down.
Zeus is probably laughing right now.
5: Almost... I can almost see the top...
What if there's nothing up there?
6: This is it. The final stretch.
One must imagine Sisyphus happy... right?

exchanges.speaker: prometheus
exchanges.text: Eagle's on lunch break! Small victories!

exchanges.speaker: prometheus
exchanges.text: Fair point. At least we're suffering together!

exchanges.speaker: prometheus
exchanges.text: You know what I miss? Fire.

exchanges.speaker: sisyphus
exchanges.text: You know what I miss? Flat ground.

exchanges.speaker: prometheus
exchanges.text: Ha! We should start a support group.

exchanges.speaker: prometheus
exchanges.text: Hey! Watch out for that steep bit ahead!
